panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Real patient Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear from a confirmed severe lead poisoning case (BLL 123 µg/dl) visibly showing pronounced basophilic stippling of erythrocytes, a classic hematologic manifestation of lead poisoning; magnified inset highlights stippled red cells. B: Real patient bone marrow aspirate from the same confirmed lead poisoning case; in-text explicitly attributes basophilic stippling to this figure and the image (including inset) shows stippled erythroid precursors, supporting the lead poisoning hematologic manifestation, though the marrow is otherwise described as normocellular.
